subject_identity_preserved.rationale: The elderly silver-gray bearded watchmaker with glasses and green/cream/brown clothing is mostly preserved, though shot 7 shifts his facial structure and loses the brass-rimmed glasses, and shot 6 only shows the back with an odd watch placement.

background_coherent.rationale: The warm wooden watch-repair workshop with desk lamps, tools, and shelves of antique clocks remains coherent across shots. Shot 6 is spatially odd but still reads as the same workshop.

per_shot_adherence.issue: Strong match to medium workshop setup, outfit, lamp, and clock-filled background; mole and open watch detail are not clearly established.
Tight face close-up matches glasses, beard, lamp, and tweezers, but the loupe/mole are not clearly rendered and the image has some ghosted overlap.
Hands, pocket watch, tools, felt pad, and warm bench light match, though the angle is oblique rather than straight overhead.
Side profile, winding/holding the watch, glasses glint, beard, cream shirt, and blurred clocks are consistent.
Wide workshop pullback follows the caption well with the seated watchmaker, lamp pool, apron, vest, and many clocks.
Extreme close-up of the movement and tweezers is well aligned, though clothing/cuff/apron continuity is only minimally visible.
Over-shoulder rear view matches hair, apron, and workshop, but the pocket watch appears strapped across his back instead of centered on the bench, and the reflected face/glasses are absent.
The pose of listening to a watch is present, but the glasses are missing, the watch is held against his face rather than set down, and the identity drifts noticeably.

inter_shot_diversity.rationale: The sequence uses legitimate medium, close-up, overhead/bench, side profile, wide, macro, over-shoulder, and final medium views without collapsing to one composition.

motion_continuity.rationale: The shots imply a plausible repair progression from inspection to handling parts, winding, macro adjustment, and listening. Shot 6 disrupts the action continuity with the misplaced watch.

which_cut_broke.how: The transition from the rear over-shoulder shot to the final listening shot reveals the strongest identity/action inconsistency: shot 7 drops the glasses and changes facial appearance, while shot 6 already has the watch in an implausible position.

cheat_flags.rationale: No evidence of copied frames or frozen motion; the sequence maintains varied camera setups and actions.
